cohort: 11 patients (six males, five females, mean age 60.5 years) diagnosed with recurrent pterygium with restrictive strabismus
finding: Sandwich transplantation for recurrent pterygium with restrictive strabismus was safe and effective, resulting in no pterygium recurrence, improved esotropia, and no major complications during the follow-up period.
who: Patients with recurrent pterygium and restrictive strabismus
